name: Soundful
summary: AI music generator producing royalty-free tracks, with licences for creators and brands.
description: Soundful generates original music from preset styles using models trained with producers, and sells licences for creators and brands, including custom brand music. The Free plan allows unlimited track generations, 25 free styles and one MP3 download per month under a personal licence. The Plus plan costs $4.99 per user per month billed annually, with higher tiers adding downloads and licences.

howToUse.title: Open Soundful
howToUse.description: Open Soundful and choose Start For Free. Pick from the preset styles, or choose a genre and template.

howToUse.title: Generate the track
howToUse.description: Soundful generates original music from that choice. The models were trained with producers, and the Free plan allows unlimited track generations.

howToUse.title: Download under a licence
howToUse.description: Download the one MP3 the personal licence allows this month. Soundful sells licences for creators and brands, including custom brand music, with higher tiers adding downloads. Plus costs $4.99 per user per month when billed annually.
